evidence.decision: Node cannot adopt a helper-created pipe; the kernel creates it (libuv FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE, so a squatter fails the listen closed), the helper replaces the default DACL (Everyone/Anonymous read) with a protected owner-only one through a WRITE_DAC client handle, the DACL is pipe-wide (new instances carry it), and the kernel drops every connection accepted before the helper reports the read-back.
